name: SCADA Communication Latency
description: Latency of the SCADA control loop between the wind farm controller and individual turbines. Checks real-time control requirements.

elements.name: SCADA Round-Trip Latency
elements.description: Network latency for control commands. Uncertain due to variable network load and weather-induced interference.

uncertainty.source: Network measurement under varying load conditions

elements.name: Maximum Control Latency
elements.description: Real-time control loop requirement for active power regulation

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(t_scada) = t_scada if t_scada <= t_scada_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The active power regulation timing requirement guards the SCADA latency uncertainty set; latencies above 100 ms prevent effective grid frequency support.
